page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor built on x86_64 architecture. The system provisions 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores via hyperthreading, backed by 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 128 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 core-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware capabilities include AVX-512 vector extensions with VNNI alongside AES encryption instructions. The instance does not include bundled local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage volumes, and delivers a baseline network throughput of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark analysis reflects consistent middle-tier performance across multi-threaded operations, counterbalanced by modest single-threaded throughput. In multi-core tests, the instance registers average tier results, including 28,006.29 in multi-core stress-ng and 10,179.0 in Geekbench multi-core. In contrast, single-core execution sits in the lower percentiles, demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core rating of 1,311.98 and single-threaded gzip compression at 22.62 GB/sec. Uncached memory throughput shows 108.04 GB/sec for read and 47.67 GB/sec for write operations, matching the expected profile of its DDR4 subsystem. Synthetic application benchmarks like Redis show solid throughput at 26.79 million operations per second, alongside 20.21 GB/sec static web serving bandwidth.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6.8xlarge provides dense compute and memory capacity suitable for horizontal scaling without incurring the overhead of specialized GPU or local NVMe hardware. The lack of bundled local storage requires deliberate storage architecture planning, but the balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio makes it cost-effective for consolidated workloads. It is functionally aligned with enterprise web serving fleets, intermediate database operations, batch ETL pipelines, and microservice clusters running within container runtimes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.8xlarge is a general-purpose compute instance equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 128 GB of memory, it maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio supported by AVX-512 instruction set extensions. The instance provides no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistence, and delivers a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.g6.8xlarge in the middle 50 percent for multi-threaded compute, memory bandwidth, and caching operations, despite modest single-core stress performance. With its balanced core-to-memory density, this server provides predictable resource allocation across horizontal scaling tiers, enterprise web servers, microservice clusters, and caching layers like Redis where sustained multi-threaded execution and reliable network connectivity are prioritized.
